headline: Taiwan Central Bank Pledges Market Monitoring Amid New Taiwan Dollar Volatility
summary: Taiwan's central bank stated it would step in to stabilize the local foreign exchange market if the New Taiwan dollar remains volatile following pressures from a global tech selloff.
why: Export-oriented economies like Taiwan are heavily sensitive to shifts in global technology cycles and foreign capital flows, which directly impact local currency stability.

impacts.name: Taiwan
impacts.why: Global technology sector selloffs drive foreign capital outflows and currency depreciation pressure.
